CADASTRE.Title: Cadastre
CADASTRE.GMOnly: Only the GM can create and edit Cadastre maps.

Manager.Title: Cadastre: maps
Manager.Empty: No maps yet. Start with “New map”.
Manager.DeleteConfirm: Delete the map {name}? An already exported scene is left untouched.

Hints.brush: Drag to paint the floor. [ and ] change the brush size.
Hints.fill: Click: fills the area with the same floor, without crossing walls.
Hints.room: Drag from corner to corner: floor, surrounding walls, inner walls removed. Existing doors stay.
Hints.wall: Drag from one cell corner to another to draw a straight wall. Alt: erase. Single click: add or remove the nearest wall.
Hints.door: Click a cell edge: door, then secret door (drawn as a wall in the scene).
Hints.prop: Click to place. R: rotate a quarter turn.
Hints.eraser: Drag to erase. Size 1 near an edge: only erases that wall.
Hints.pan: Right click or middle button (or Space + click) to pan, wheel to zoom.

Panel.Name: Name
Panel.ApplyHint: Anything outside the new size is removed (Ctrl+Z to go back).

Export.Title: Export to scene
Export.Choice: This map already has a scene: {scene}. Updating it replaces its background and the walls placed by Cadastre; tokens, lights and hand-placed walls stay.
Export.Empty: The map is empty: nothing to export.
Export.Reduced: Very large map: the image is reduced to {size} px per side, Foundry stretches it to the scene size.
